business_summary: Keurig Dr Pepper Inc. owns, manufactures, and distributors beverages and single serve brewing systems in the United States and internationally. The company operates through three segments: U.S. Refreshment Beverages, U.S. Coffee, and International. It manufactures and distributes branded concentrates, syrup, and finished beverages, as well as sales of owned brands and third-party brands; tea, cocoa, and other products; and offers finished goods relating to K-Cup pods, single serve brewers, specialty coffee, and ready to drink coffee products. The company offers its products under the Dr Pepper, Canada Dry, Mott's, A&W, Peñafiel, GHOST, Snapple, 7UP, Green Mountain Coffee Roasters, Clamato, Core Hydration, The Original Donut Shop, Sunkist soda, Squirt, C4 Energy, Hawaiian Punch, Electrolit, Bloom, Bai, Evian, Yoo-Hoo, Vita Coco, Big Red, RC Cola, Crush, McCafé, Tim Hortons, Van Houtte, Celestial Seasonings, Bigelow, Starbucks, Dunkin', Folgers, Peet's, and Swiss Miss brands, as well as other partner and private label brands. It markets and sells its products to supermarkets, mass merchandisers, club stores, e-commerce retailers, office superstores, vending machines, fountains, grocery and drug stores, convenience stores, and other small outlets; and directly to consumers through Keurig.com website. Keurig Dr Pepper Inc. was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Frisco, Texas.
business_summary_ko: Keurig Dr Pepper Inc.는 미국 및 전 세계에서 음료 및 일회용 양조 시스템을 소유, 제조 및 유통합니다. 이 회사는 미국 다과 음료, 미국 커피 및 국제이라는 세 가지 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 브랜드 농축액, 시럽, 완제품 음료를 제조 및 유통할 뿐만 아니라 자체 브랜드 및 타사 브랜드도 판매합니다. 차, 코코아 및 기타 제품; K-Cup 포드, 1인용 브루어, 스페셜티 커피, 바로 마실 수 있는 커피 제품과 관련된 완제품을 제공합니다. 회사는 Dr Pepper, Canada Dry, Mott's, A&W, Peñafiel, GHOST, Snapple, 7UP, Green Mountain Coffee Roasters, Clamato, Core Hydration, The Original Donut Shop, Sunkist 소다, Squirt, C4 Energy, Hawaiian Punch, Electrolit, Bloom, Bai, Evian, Yu-Hoo, Vita Coco, Big Red, RC Cola, Crush, McCafé, Tim Hortons, Van Houtte, Celestial Seasonings, Bigelow, Starbucks, Dunkin', Folgers, Peet's, Swiss Miss 브랜드는 물론 기타 파트너 및 자사 브랜드 브랜드도 포함됩니다. 슈퍼마켓, 대량 판매점, 클럽 상점, 전자 상거래 소매점, 사무실 슈퍼마켓, 자동 판매기, 분수대, 식료품점에 제품을 판매하고 있습니다.
